releaseNotes.page.title: What's new
releaseNotes.page.description: What changed in each version and how to try it.
releaseNotes.page.empty: There are no updates to show yet.
releaseNotes.page.openHint: See what changed in each version.
releaseNotes.version.label: Version {version}
releaseNotes.surface.label: Shown on
releaseNotes.popup.title: What's new
releaseNotes.v0141.summary: Conversations look better, and a language setting, team emoji and agent costs are new.
releaseNotes.v0141.typingChanged: Under the composer, the name of who is typing is bold and three dots move. With Reduce Motion on, the dots stay still.
releaseNotes.v0141.typingTryIt: Watch the line under the composer while a person or an agent is writing a reply.
releaseNotes.v0141.channelNotificationsC: A channel's notification line shows its state with a bell icon and words. It flips the moment you tap, and if saving fails only that channel goes back.
releaseNotes.v0141.channelNotificationsT: On the phone, tap the notification line on the conversation info page, in the ⋮ menu or in a channel row menu. On the desktop, use the channel header ⋮ menu or the sidebar row menu.
releaseNotes.v0141.photoViewerChanged: A photo grows out of the picture you tapped and closes back into it. Back, Esc or a drag down closes it, and with Reduce Motion on it opens and closes at once.
releaseNotes.v0141.photoViewerTryIt: Open a photo in a conversation and close it in a few different ways.
releaseNotes.v0141.composerHeightChanged: The composer grows to four lines on the phone and five on the desktop, then scrolls inside. A long pasted text fits its height and the last line is no longer clipped.
releaseNotes.v0141.composerHeightTryIt: Type several lines, then paste a long text.
releaseNotes.v0141.phoneConversationChan: The band at the top of a conversation is gone: back, the name and ⋮ float as three glass buttons. Coming back to the app or unlocking the phone reconnects sooner, pulling down at the top of a conversation re-checks the connection, and a light tap comes with a long press or a reaction.
releaseNotes.v0141.phoneConversationTryI: Open a conversation and scroll to the top, then leave the app for a moment and come back. If the disconnected band shows, tap Reconnect now.
releaseNotes.v0141.settingsTitle: Language setting and phone theme picker
releaseNotes.v0141.settingsChanged: Settings › Profile › Language lets you follow the device language or pick 한국어 or English. It applies at once, though not every screen is translated yet. On the phone, Settings › Theme › Theme style opens a full-screen picker.
releaseNotes.v0141.settingsTryIt: Change the language and check that the settings screen changes. On the phone, also pick a theme style.
releaseNotes.v0141.emojiChanged: On the phone, reactions and status take every standard emoji. The Our team slot of the emoji picker holds team emoji, stickers and GIFs, and you can register new ones.
releaseNotes.v0141.emojiTryIt: On the phone, tap + in the quick reaction row and search by name. On both, open the Our team slot of the emoji picker.
releaseNotes.v0141.agentsTitle: Agent costs and calling an agent in a DM
releaseNotes.v0141.agentsChanged: Agent lists and profiles show this month's cost, and admins get a monthly report. In a DM between people, calling an agent first asks everyone for consent, and the agent joins once all agree.
releaseNotes.v0141.agentsTryIt: Open the agent list and a profile. As an admin, open Settings › Usage on the desktop or Settings › Monthly report on the phone. In a DM, mention an agent and look for the consent card.
releaseNotes.v0142.summary: Link previews and threads are redesigned, and the phone gets an expression button while the Mac gets a menu bar icon.
releaseNotes.v0142.linkPreviewChanged: Link cards now default to Small, show a site icon and a video mark, and appear on the phone too. Paste a link and a card shows above the composer before you send, and ✕ sends just this message without a preview.
releaseNotes.v0142.linkPreviewTryIt: Paste a link into a conversation. Choose Small, Large or Off in Settings › Display › Link previews on the phone, or in Settings › Appearance › Conversation display on web and desktop.
releaseNotes.v0142.threadsChanged: The thread summary under a message now shows overlapping faces, the reply count and a new-replies chip, and following a thread brings alerts for new replies. On the phone, swipe a message from right to left to reply in its thread.
releaseNotes.v0142.threadsTryIt: Open a thread from the summary line under a message and choose Follow thread in its header. On the phone, try swiping a message too.
releaseNotes.v0142.expressionsChanged: A new expression button left of Send on the phone opens one sheet to search emoticons, emoji, team emoji and GIFs. Use Add to import from an album or a link, or Make with AI to have your team's image model turn one photo into a background-removed or caricature emoticon.
releaseNotes.v0142.expressionsTryIt: On the phone, tap the expression button next to the composer. Open Make with AI from the Team emoji tab on the phone or the Our team slot of the emoji picker on desktop; with no image model on your team, you'll see how to connect one.
releaseNotes.v0142.menuBarTitle: Mac menu bar and closing the window
releaseNotes.v0142.menuBarChanged: An oort icon now sits in the Mac menu bar, with a dot when something is unread. While you're signed in, closing the window keeps the app running in the menu bar so notifications keep coming.
releaseNotes.v0142.menuBarTryIt: Click the menu bar icon to see running tasks. To quit, use Quit oort or ⌘Q, and reopen the window with Open oort or from the Dock.
releaseNotes.v0142.connectionChanged: The connecting notice appears only after a full second, and when the connection fails it says whether you are offline or the server cannot be reached. Unsent messages and attachments get icons to send again or delete, and messages that failed on a network error go out again on their own once you reconnect.
releaseNotes.v0142.connectionTryIt: When your connection is shaky, watch when the connection notice appears. If a message did not go through, use the icons beside it to send it again or delete it.
releaseNotes.v0142.editAndViewChanged: Press ↑ in an empty composer to edit your last message, and the message ⋮ menu is shorter with Edit at the top for your own messages. Attachments sit in a one-row card strip inside the composer, up to 20, and the image viewer gains zoom out, fit and zoom in controls plus a Copy image button.
releaseNotes.v0142.editAndViewTryIt: Press ↑ in an empty composer, then attach a few files and open an image at full size.
releaseNotes.v0142.phoneMediaTitle: Phone video playback and saving attachments
releaseNotes.v0142.phoneMediaChanged: On the phone, tap a video attachment to play it right in the app. Saving is now separate from sharing: photos and videos go straight to your photo library, and for other files you pick a place in the Files app.
releaseNotes.v0142.phoneMediaTryIt: Tap a video card to play it. Then use Save in the photo viewer, or the ↓ on a file card, to save to Photos or Files.
releaseNotes.v0142.passwordResetChanged: Admins create a link with “Create reset link” in a member profile, usable once within 24 hours, and every other device of that member signs out once they choose a new password. On the sign-in screen, “Forgot your password?” tells you to ask an admin for a link and copies a request message for you.
releaseNotes.v0142.passwordResetTryIt: As an admin, open “Create reset link” in a member profile. On the sign-in screen, select “Forgot your password?” to read the steps.
releaseNotes.v0142.conversationsLine1: Reaction chips are now pills, and the ones you added have an accent outline.
releaseNotes.v0142.conversationsLine2: A stopped run shows as a quiet centered system line, worded the same everywhere.
releaseNotes.v0142.conversationsLine3: A message carries up to three link cards, and older Korean sites no longer show garbled text.
releaseNotes.v0142.conversationsLine4: Check “Also send to the conversation” on a thread reply and it shows there too, with a link back to the thread.
releaseNotes.v0142.attachmentsLine1: Wide screenshots use more of the conversation column, so their text is readable before you open them.
releaseNotes.v0142.attachmentsLine2: On the phone, the tap that closes the share sheet no longer opens the thread underneath.
releaseNotes.v0142.attachmentsLine3: Pinch anywhere in the phone photo viewer; very long pictures can fill the screen, and a double tap shows full size.
releaseNotes.v0142.notificationsLine1: Opening a notification clears stacked sheets and dialogs and goes straight to that message, keeping your draft.
releaseNotes.v0142.notificationsLine2: Threads you reply in or are mentioned in are followed on their own, and notification settings can turn their alerts off.
releaseNotes.v0142.notificationsLine3: An approval alert is one question, and a one-line receipt stays after you decide.
releaseNotes.v0142.notificationsLine4: On the Mac, clicking a notification banner now opens the right message.
releaseNotes.v0142.agentsLine1: On desktop, a plan button in the conversation header shows how many steps are left when an agent reports a plan.
releaseNotes.v0142.agentsLine2: The desktop work panel and phone work record sheet split what the agent reported from what oort measured.
releaseNotes.v0142.agentsLine3: A tool call has one approval card, and a rejected, expired or canceled approval closes its call card as stopped.
releaseNotes.v0142.agentsLine4: After you approve a tool call, its approval card goes on to show the result, and no separate result row appears.
releaseNotes.v0142.agentsLine5: Phone approval cards get a button to request again, which puts a draft message in the composer.
releaseNotes.v0142.agentsLine6: On the phone, the Home working card and the Agents tab mark an agent that is waiting for approval.
releaseNotes.v0142.agentsLine7: In the inbox, a decided approval becomes a one-line receipt, and its buttons vanish once another device has decided.
releaseNotes.v0142.agentsLine8: For code work the helper offers a Hand a task to my Mac card, and it reads text, PDF and image attachments.
releaseNotes.v0142.agentsLine9: On a team server, agents can now read photos you send in a conversation.
releaseNotes.v0142.agentsLine10: On the phone, a line above the composer in agent conversations shows who is working, and tapping it opens a sheet.
releaseNotes.v0142.agentsLine11: On the phone, requests show an agent status chip, plus a line saying what to do if it was not picked up or failed.
releaseNotes.v0142.agentsLine12: After you decide in the inbox, the receipt line no longer shows twice, and an approval card states its time left once.
releaseNotes.v0142.agentsLine13: On the phone, a finished request gets a chip with its time and step count, and tapping it opens the work record.
releaseNotes.v0142.agentsLine14: Admins pick the team AI key, helper name and abilities in onboarding and settings, and can switch abilities by chat.
releaseNotes.v0142.agentsLine15: Team AI usage is unlimited by default, and admins can turn on a daily or monthly limit in Usage limits in settings.
releaseNotes.v0142.settingsLine1: What's new now lives in Settings: it opens once after an update, and each version's notes can be reread there.
releaseNotes.v0142.settingsLine2: The Beta tag on Language is gone, and phone haptics are fixed to Rich with no setting to choose.
releaseNotes.v0142.settingsLine3: The sign-in screen remembers your email for each server, and the first screen has a language chip at the top right.
releaseNotes.v0142.settingsLine4: Guest invites are paused until channel-specific invites are ready, so Guest is not offered when inviting.
releaseNotes.v0142.settingsLine5: If your saved sign-in was cleared, web and desktop no longer stay on the loading screen and go to sign-in instead.
releaseNotes.v0142.networkLine1: On the phone, a band above Home, Inbox and Agents tells you when the device is offline or the server cannot be reached.
releaseNotes.v0142.networkLine2: Web and desktop show a connection card under the sidebar, and sending stays open if only the live connection drops.
releaseNotes.v0142.networkLine3: Web and desktop reconnect when a window that was hidden for over 30 seconds comes back.
releaseNotes.v0142.networkLine4: Unsent messages stay on this device through a channel switch or reload, and two or more get a Resend all button.
releaseNotes.v0142.networkLine5: A failed load or upload now says why, and the sign-in screen explains an expired session or an unreachable server.
releaseNotes.v0142.networkLine6: On web and desktop, a blocked composer or approval row now says whether you are offline or the server is unreachable.
releaseNotes.v0142.phoneLine1: In the channel list, rows without new posts turn gray and rows with new posts get a count chip.
releaseNotes.v0142.phoneLine2: Touching a row just to scroll no longer flashes its pressed color.
releaseNotes.v0142.phoneLine3: While typing, dragging the conversation down lowers the keyboard and rests the composer to one line.
releaseNotes.v0142.phoneLine4: Returning to the app no longer sweeps the list downward, and arrival highlights are lighter and shorter.
releaseNotes.v0142.desktopLine1: Even with a long channel name, the header buttons stay inside the pane and the title shortens to one line.
releaseNotes.v0142.desktopLine2: In a narrow window with the sidebar open, the channel composer keeps its minimum width.
releaseNotes.v0142.desktopLine3: Tooltips appear sooner, and on the Mac right-clicking message text opens the message menu.
releaseNotes.v0142.teamExpressionsLine1: When you register a team expression, you pick a kind, Team emoji or Emoticon, or accept the suggestion.
releaseNotes.v0142.teamExpressionsLine2: Expression views no longer overlap, and the three web panel views are named Team emoji, Emoticon and GIF.
releaseNotes.v0142.teamExpressionsLine3: A photo emoticon whose background could not be removed is no longer described as background removed.
releaseNotes.v0143.summary: Phone search is rebuilt, agent replies gather in threads, and phone alerts wait while you use the desktop.
releaseNotes.v0143.phoneSearchTitle: Phone search and search inside a conversation
releaseNotes.v0143.phoneSearchChanged: The search screen now finds people, channels and messages from one box, and opens with your recently opened chats and recent searches. The magnifier in a conversation header searches only that conversation, and tapping one of its results jumps to the message with your words highlighted in the bubble.
releaseNotes.v0143.phoneSearchTryIt: Open the search screen and type a name or a few words from a message. Then open a conversation, tap the magnifier in its header, tap a result and use the ↑ ↓ bar to move between results.
releaseNotes.v0143.agentThreadsTitle: Agent replies go to a thread
releaseNotes.v0143.agentThreadsChanged: When you call an agent in a channel, its answer, approval cards and tool lines gather in a thread under your message. A 1:1 DM between you and an agent still answers in the conversation itself. The tick chip that marked a finished job is gone, while chips for other states, such as working, waiting for approval or failed, stay.
releaseNotes.v0143.agentThreadsTryIt: Call an agent in a channel, then open the thread from the replies line under your message to read the answer.
releaseNotes.v0143.phoneDelayTitle: Delaying phone alerts while you use the desktop
releaseNotes.v0143.phoneDelayChanged: While you use the web or desktop app, phone alerts for mentions, DMs and thread replies wait one minute by default, and are skipped if you read the message first. Approval requests and work-finished alerts are never delayed, and the server only learns that you are active, which other members cannot see.
releaseNotes.v0143.phoneDelayTryIt: In the web or desktop app, open “Delay phone alerts while I use the desktop” in Settings › Notifications and choose Off, 1 min or 5 min.
releaseNotes.v0143.quoteCardChanged: A reply that quotes a message is now one card: a header that says “Replying to” with the name and one line of the original, a thin divider, then the message. The old vertical bar is gone, the quote chip above the composer matches, and an agent answering the message right above it no longer repeats it as a quote.
releaseNotes.v0143.quoteCardTryIt: Reply to a message, then tap the header of the quote card to jump to the original.
releaseNotes.v0143.quietConnectionChange: The “Can't reach the server” notice now re-checks on its own and clears itself once the server is back, with no tap or message needed. On the phone, returning to the app no longer announces a drop you never saw, “Reconnected” fades by itself, and a conversation opens already at the bottom instead of moving down from the top.
releaseNotes.v0143.quietConnectionTryIt: Leave the app for a moment, come back and open a conversation. If the can't-reach-the-server notice shows, watch whether it clears by itself once the server is back.
releaseNotes.v0143.editMessageTitle: Editing messages and seeing when you edited
releaseNotes.v0143.editMessageChanged: Your own messages get a pencil button in the hover toolbar, and on the phone Edit is now the top row of the long-press sheet. The Edited mark now shows when you edited, as a tooltip on hover on web and desktop and when you tap it on the phone.
releaseNotes.v0143.editMessageTryIt: Hover over one of your messages, click the pencil and edit it, then point at Edited. On the phone, long-press your message, tap Edit at the top, then tap Edited.
releaseNotes.v0143.composerPickerTitle: Composer attachments and the emoticon picker
releaseNotes.v0143.composerPickerChanged: On the phone, the + button works with the keyboard open, and attached photos sit in a small preview row inside the composer with a ✕ to remove each. The emoticon picker now has three tabs, Team, Emoji and GIF, and on the phone the “Loading” that kept repeating each time you opened it is fixed.
releaseNotes.v0143.composerPickerTryIt: On the phone, keep the keyboard open and attach a photo with +. Then open the emoticon picker with the smiley button in the composer and look through the three tabs.
releaseNotes.v0143.menuBarPlanetTitle: The orange planet in the menu bar icon
releaseNotes.v0143.menuBarPlanetChanged: When something is unread, the oort icon in the Mac menu bar turns its small top right planet orange instead of adding a dot. With nothing unread, it stays a single plain color as before.
releaseNotes.v0143.menuBarPlanetTryIt: Compare the menu bar icon when you have unread notifications and after you have read them all.
releaseNotes.v0143.searchLine1: On the “Messages” chip, “Choose conversation” narrows the search to a single conversation.
releaseNotes.v0143.searchLine2: Home search and in-conversation search share one recent list, and “All conversations” repeats a search everywhere.
releaseNotes.v0143.searchLine3: Going to an older message from search, a pin or a quote loads earlier chat (you can cancel), or shows a note if too far.
releaseNotes.v0143.conversationsLine1: Also send to the conversation is gone from thread replies, and ones already sent that way now show only in the thread.
releaseNotes.v0143.conversationsLine2: On web and desktop, sending no longer flashes a Sending line that shifts rows, and only a slow send shows a small clock.
releaseNotes.v0143.conversationsLine3: In a thread, a quote that points at the top message is no longer shown, so the same words are not repeated.
releaseNotes.v0143.attachmentsLine1: On web and desktop, attaching files makes the composer grow less, with a tighter gap between the cards and your text.
releaseNotes.v0143.attachmentsLine2: On web and desktop, the ✕ on a link card shows only on hover or keyboard selection, and always on touch screens.
releaseNotes.v0143.expressionsLine1: The kinds you pick when registering are now Small emoticon (goes into the input) and Large emoticon (preview first).
releaseNotes.v0143.notificationsLine1: Read items in the inbox no longer keep an unread dot, on the phone, web and desktop.
releaseNotes.v0143.notificationsLine2: When remote work asks for approval, the phone alert goes only to the session owner who can decide.
releaseNotes.v0143.agentsLine1: Web and desktop work console and emoticon lists now say if a failed load is offline or an unreachable server.
releaseNotes.v0143.agentsLine2: The web and desktop work panel now calls its session list “Work sessions” and its host status “Where it runs”.
releaseNotes.v0143.networkLine1: On the phone, the connection band no longer lingers for over 30 seconds until you unlock the phone.
releaseNotes.v0143.networkLine2: On web and desktop, a failed load is no longer announced twice: one sidebar line and one box in the main pane.
releaseNotes.v0143.networkLine3: On web and desktop, failed loads in sidebar DMs, drafts, mentions and the team board say why and keep saved content.
releaseNotes.v0143.networkLine4: On web and desktop, the inbox offline band calls the list a snapshot only when a saved list shows below it.
releaseNotes.v0143.phoneLine1: The Home + menu and the attach + menu follow your chosen theme, so a dark theme no longer shows a white panel.
releaseNotes.v0143.phoneLine2: Korean text in message bubbles now wraps at spaces, so words are far less often cut in the middle.
releaseNotes.v0143.desktopLine1: The hover toolbar now leaves with the pointer after you close the ⋮ menu or pick an action from it.
releaseNotes.v0143.desktopLine2: A work band appearing above the composer no longer hides the hover toolbar beneath it while the pointer rests.
releaseNotes.v0143.desktopLine3: The thread reply box on web and desktop now looks like the channel composer.
